summary: Recovery review note: the missing hardening-base module must be materialized from the trusted PR base ref into the same trusted-swarm directory as swarmctl.py and swarmctl_hardening.py. Do not resolve the import from the request checkout, or the ownership validator would execute request-supplied code across its trust boundary.
evidence: Current main workflow materializes swarmctl.py and swarmctl_hardening.py with git show origin/${GITHUB_BASE_REF}:..., then executes the copied hardening facade from RUNNER_TEMP.
Current hardening facade imports swarmctl_hardening_base; that base module itself imports swarmctl, so all three modules form the trusted validator module graph.
The recovery acceptance explicitly requires the trusted validator to remain exclusively base-branch code rather than request-supplied code.
